entry.title: Mira v1.7.9 Beta 1 Update
entry.summary: Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.7.9 Beta 1!
entry.content:
Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.7.9 Beta 1!​

This update includes bug fixes and additional changes. See the full changelog below.

version change
This update runs on v19 of Among Us and requires a fresh install!

Changelog​

Role Bugfixes
Impostors
  • Ambusher's animation no longer breaks.
  • Fix Parasite not being able to open meeting chat.
  • Fixed Escapist recall sprite layering.
  • Fixed Miner vent layering.
Neutrals
  • Fixed "frozen" stones not actually appearing as stone.
  • Chef keeps track of disconnected served players to prevent an impossible win.
Other Bug Fixes
  • Disable Submerged button for Ghostwalkers.
  • Fixed loading issues with Submerged. Note that this means every player is required to have it when using it.
  • Fixed issues with draft not giving roles or simply not listening to other player picks.
  • Fixed map decoration on Skeld.
  • Fixed save data not saving.
Improvements, Additions & Changes
Improvements
  • Ambassador's Selection menu now has two circles of roles to display more at once.
  • Zoom is no longer easy to trigger on mobile.
  • Prevent zooming in draft.
  • Fix issues with custom text icons clipping in UI.
Balancing Tweaks
  • By default, Hunter will need to wait a round before they can kill a caught player without being punished for it if they are crew.
Additions
  • Added implementation for the new match info guide, as well as a temporary toggle.
  • Added the ability to see chat notifications outside of the lobby.
  • Added settings to toggle sabotages when dead and when too few players are alive.
  • Added Achievements Support (bundled in this release). Added basic Mutually-Exclusive role buckets.
Changes
  • Rainbow color is a bit slower and is more optimized now.
  • Added Nameplates and Visor support via Corsac Cosmetics, requiring it for all future releases.
  • Removed Classic Mode for Players. Innersloth's changes have made it unfeasible to try getting it to work again.

entry.title: Mira v1.7.3 Update
entry.summary: Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.7.3!
entry.content:
Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.7.3!​

This update includes bug fixes and additional changes. See the full changelog below.

version change
This update runs on v18 of Among Us and requires a fresh install!

Changelog​

Role Bugfixes
Crewmates
  • Sheriff: Fixed broken punishment explanation in tab description.
  • Altruist: Fixed broken tab description.
  • Mirrorcaster: Magic Mirrors no longer stay permanently if the Mirrorcaster is converted.
Impostors
  • Morphling: If configured, the Morph ability uses are no longer able to go less than 0.
Neutrals
  • Survivor: Survivor no longer takes wins away from Impostors.
  • Plaguebearer: Adjusted checks to rule out the possibility of duplicate plague on a player.
  • Werewolf: Werewolf's short-burst kill cooldown is no longer affected by cooldown changes.
  • Chef: Added safeguards against the possible occurrence of missing dead bodies, breaking the win conditions.
Draft Mode & Other Bug Fixes
Draft Mode Bug Fixes
  • Target-based roles like Fairy and Executioner have targets assigned properly again.
  • Concurrent picks no longer removes picks from other player.
Other Bug Fixes
  • Fixed bad AU code causing anti-cheat to kick non-hosts if they voted for someone who died in the meeting.
  • Fixed non-classic roles appearing in the settings menu.
  • Fixed missing causes of death appearing due to locale system changes.
  • Fixed Assailant Modifier Options text.
  • Fixed kill cooldown for Impostors not being based on overall cooldown offsets.
Changes
Other Changes
  • Added Ghostwalker Auto-Venting setting upon spawning under Game Mechanics.
  • Added Judge's punishment as a setting for Prosecutor's punishment (now the default).
  • Reshuffling in Draft Mode gives you spare time to pick if necessary.

entry.title: Mira v1.7.2 Update
entry.summary: Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.7.2!
entry.content:
Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.7.2!​

This update includes bug fixes and additional changes. See the full changelog below.

version change
This update runs on v18 of Among Us and requires a fresh install!

Changelog​

Role & Modifier Bugfixes
Crewmates
  • Haunter: Dead killers no longer get an arrow to a revealed Haunter.
  • Deputy: No longer guessable after being revealed.
  • Prosecutor: Prosecute uses text is no longer broken.
  • Time Lord: Final evil being revived no longer ends the game with a crewmate win.
  • Swapper: Swapped players properly carry over their colorblind text.
Neutrals
  • Doomsayer: If Doomsayer continues the game and is supposed to win the game when all guesses are completed, the game will no longer end in a crewmate win.
  • Doomsayer: Guess information is properly tracked for other players.
  • Plaguebearer: Pestilence transformation is fixed for edge cases.
Modifiers
  • Deadly Quota: The last kill of the game is properly counted towards the quota now.
  • Overclocker: Overclock no longer grants impostors a 0 second kill cooldown.
  • Tiebreaker: Tiebreaker no longer continues the game while dead.
  • Noisemaker: Noisemaker no longer stays lingering even when a body is cleaned up.
  • Bait: Fixed bait reports occurring even if a body was cleaned up in time.
Draft Mode & Other Bug Fixes
Draft Mode Bug Fixes
  • Amount of choices is no longer affected by the number of players present.
  • Shuffling no longer reduces the number of options you get.
Other Bug Fixes
  • Concealed changes such as Ambusher, Morphling, and Swooper no longer carry into meetings.
  • Added support for the latest Level Imposter release.
  • Fixed broken Submerged patching.
  • Neutral Killers no longer take full priority over win conditions. This now fixes game draws.
Changes
Notable Changes
  • Mod now runs on Among Us v18.0.x.
  • Prosecutor, Politician, Mayor, and Hypnotist have now switched to the new meeting abilities system.
  • The Win Condition system has been rewritten. Neutral Benigns are treated as majority Crewmates if at least two main factions (Crew, Imps, NKs) exist. Otherwise, they will be ignored from win checks. Survivor can also win solo if only NBs remain.
  • Vampire is counted as two Neutral Killing slots under Draft Mode now.
Other Changes
  • By default, Janitor can clean and kill separately only if they're by themselves.
  • Mayor and Deputy will still say their role on their name even if they are converted.

entry.title: Mira v1.7.1 Update
entry.summary: Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.7.1!
entry.content:
Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.7.1!​

This update includes bug fixes and some rolechanges. See the full changelog below.

IMPORTANT
This update runs on v17.4 of Among Us and requires a fresh install.

Do not just replace files as this will cause issues.

Changelog​

Role & Modifier Bugfixes
Crewmates
  • Lookout shuffles its watch findings properly again.
  • Seer Reveal mode checks its options properly.
  • Converted Jailor no longer leaves jailee in a broken state.
  • Knighted Mayor no longer gets double votes.
  • Imitator no longer shows (Imi) while dead.
Impostors
  • Ambassador retrain is consistently functional on teammates now.
  • Ambassador retrain no longer sets the trainee's kill cooldown to 0.
  • Traitor no longer shows (Traitor) while dead.
Neutrals
  • Executioner, Fairy, and Inquisitor check for disconnected targets properly.
  • Fixed errors thrown by unshattered Medusa stones that broke the whole game.
Modifiers
  • Celebrity shows death by the Spectre properly.
  • Circumvent uses are no longer bypassed with a meeting.
Draft Mode & Other Bug Fixes
Draft Mode Bug Fixes
  • Draft no longer softlocks if Host disconnects.
  • Draft UI is no longer left behind during role intro or when leaving mid-draft.
  • Alignment Mode no longer shows the actual faction instead.
Other Bug Fixes
  • End Game Summary shows role icons for disconnected players.
  • Fixed the biggest source of memory leaking.
  • Fixed crashing for Epic Games and Xbox Game Pass users.
  • Game Options should no longer desync when initially joining.
Changes
Crewmate Changes
  • Prosecutor now stops swaps from happening.
  • Monarch can now optionally reveal knighting in the meeting.
Impostors Changes
  • Venerer can now cancel their ability early.
Neutrals Changes
  • Victims of Executioner Torment, Jester Haunt, and Spectre Spook are publicly announced.
Other Changes
  • Added Role Icon on Role Reveal screen local toggle.

entry.title: Mira v1.7.0 Update
entry.summary: Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.7.0!
entry.content:
Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.7.0!​

This update is packed with big changes and new additions, including:

  • Draft Mode is now part of the base mod!
  • A new Impostor and a new Crewmate role!
  • 2 new modifiers!
  • A new pet!

Also included are a number of changes to existing roles and modifiers, as well as bug fixes and improvements. See the full changelog below.

IMPORTANT
This update runs on v17.4 of Among Us and requires a full reinstall.

Do not just replace files as this will cause issues.

New Roles!​

  • The Barkeeper is a Crewmate Support role that can drink with others to roleblock them. They may also spill a drink to speed up or slow down other players.

  • The Bootlegger is an Impostor Support role that can drink with others to roleblock them. Once a player is roleblocked three times, they will die of poison.

New Modifiers!​

  • Drunk (Universal) — Your controls are permanently inverted. You are also immune to normal roleblocks.
  • Overclocker (Assailant) — You may decrease your cooldowns at the cost of longer cooldowns once your Overclock is over. After an additional round, your cooldowns will normalize.

Changelog​

Role & Modifier Bugfixes
Crewmates
  • Investigator footprints are layered correctly for every map.
  • Medium's Spirit displays arrows for everyone properly.
  • "Medium can Identify" setting properly makes ghosts anonymous.
  • Mystic arrows no longer appear if their duration is 0 seconds.
  • Swapper and Prosecutor vote changes reflect on Executioner, Jester, and Hunter.
  • Disconnected Medics will not leave their shields behind on players anymore.
  • Disconnected players that are protected will return uses to Medic, Mirrorcaster, and Warden.
  • Noisemaker will properly check for rotting bodies or stoned players.
  • Imitator priority is fixed for roles like Forensic.
Impostors
  • Venerer abilities no longer reset from an additional kill.
  • Added checks for Ambassador and Traitor to throw warnings when no roles are available.
  • Miner explosion no longer appears on invisible vent.
Neutrals
  • Executioner and Doomsayer leave notifications appear properly for everyone now.
  • Doomsayer killing all victims at once setting is fixed, and no longer kills just one player.
  • Glitch hack no longer prevents killers from being able to kill for the remainder of the game.
  • Inquisitor will win solo in a 1v1 and will not take away wins in a 1v1 with dead heretics (PR #225).
Modifiers
  • Crewpostor Vigilante can no longer guess other impostors.
Other Bug Fixes
  • Fixed problems with the End Game Timer breaking and erroring.
  • Submerged will no longer break in the role reveal.
  • Neutral Wildcard no longer duplicates the amount of each neutral present (PR #191).
  • Wiki hyperlinks will check for gamemode-specific roles properly.
  • Full support for Among Us v17.4.
Role & Modifier Changes
Crewmate Changes
  • Lookout by default sees who interacts, rather than what roles interact.
  • In the "See Players" mode, Lookout will not be able to see Bomber or any other indirect attacks.
  • Seer can optionally only use their ability once per round and/or compare each player once per game (PR #231).
  • Deputy, by default, will warn their camped target's killer about a Deputy existing (PR #209).
  • Deputy will now reveal themselves upon a successful shot.
  • Prosecutor now has a full-screen animation for prosecutes.
  • Time Lord, by default, will revive players for a single round, and make them die after the next meeting ends.
  • Medic now sees "Darker / Lighter" on all players rather than just on living players.
  • Transporter now uses a single multi-select menu for transporting players.
Impostors Changes
  • Swooper can optionally be untrackable while swooping. (PR #201).
  • Blackmailed players no longer immediately skip if too many players are alive.
Neutrals Changes
  • Doomsayer shows guessing progress next to their name.
  • Doomsayer no longer sees disabled roles in their feedback
  • Jester has an optional limited duration and cooldown adjustment for venting (PR #237).
  • Jester can now Poke players, triggering roles like Warden, Cleric, Herbalist, Lookout, and more (PR #205).
  • Soul Collector has been permanently replaced by Medusa. This rework makes players slowly fade into stone, and allows Transporters to still interact with them to an extent. Non-shattered stones will remain throughout rounds as evidence.
  • Chef shows feeding progress on their name.
  • Inquisitor marks off any Heretic roles that have died in their role tab.
  • Inquisitor now has a Heretic progress count next to their name.
Modifier Changes
  • Tiebreaker now stalls the game as a solo Crewmate, or as a Jester / Executioner in a 1v1 / 1v2.
Other Changes
  • Unity Rich Text is no longer allowed on players to prevent issues with tag abuse (PR #206).
  • Lobby Rules are now limited to being displayed at 3-second intervals due to malicious players who sell cheat mods to disrupt lobbies.
  • Task tracking is mostly up for preference now, with the host simply toggling if other task amounts can be seen by the dead.
  • All local game options are moved to 6 different categories.
Additions & Improvements
Additions
  • @idkimneil's Draft Mode is now part of the base mod. This can be toggled in the Role Distribution settings.
  • Added Perfect Comms (Prox-Chat) role integration on the mod itself (PR #226) - REQUIRES UPDATE TO PERFECT COMMS 4.1.7 OR NEWER!
  • Added Overclocker, an Assailant modifier that speeds up cooldowns for more general killers but then slows cooldowns afterwards.
  • Added Drunk, a Universal modifier that also has roleblock immunity.
  • Barkeeper joins the Crewmate Support alignment with a standard roleblock ability and also a spill ability, changing player speed for anyone who steps in it.
  • Bootlegger joins the Impostor Support alignment with a roleblock ability that slowly turns into poison.
  • Added "Full Save Cooldown Multiplier" for full protective roles.
  • Added the all-important Flopster pet (she's a little silly).
Improvements
  • Options for roles and modifiers display changes in a similar fashion to vanilla's option notifications.
  • Hovering over the role list text in the lobby is now adjusted for the corresponding gamemode selected.
  • Player text in meetings will now shrink depending on the amount of text within it.
  • Meeting kill animations are synced for every player.
  • In-Game Wiki will no longer stutter when reopening the roles search tab.
  • Abilities disabled on round one now show that they are, in fact, disabled for that reason.
  • More roles have additional visual and audio work.
  • Game Modifiers display if they are guessable within their wiki entries.
  • Roles now have their icons displayed in text.
  • Wiki Hyperlinks in text will now display their corresponding icons.

entry.title: v1.6.3 Update
entry.summary: Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.6.3!
entry.content:
Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.6.3!​

This version runs on the latest version of Among Us (v17.4). A fresh install is recommended to ensure no conflicts with old files!

See the full changelog below.

Changelog​

Role & Modifier Bugfixes
Crewmates
  • Officer now sees Prosecutor as a valid killer.
  • Monarch is no longer immune to basic interactions when they have a shield.
  • Cleric Barrier duration is no longer tied to its cooldown.
  • Warden no longer resets cooldowns to one second.
  • Engineer and Plumber interact with vents in a more optimized fashion. (PR #190 by @TheDavSmasher)
  • Plumber barricades prevent all venters from entering properly. (PR #192 by @TheDavSmasher)
  • Sentry Cameras are no longer placed below the map.
Impostors
  • Shapeshifter now inherits fake shields on players, like how Morphling / Glitch do.
  • Parasite and Puppeteer can interact with Ladders, Platforms, and Ziplines properly. PR #176, DrFreezyYT.
  • Pet Button no longer interferes with forced player map interactions.
Neutrals
  • Arsonist douse count is no longer more than intended.
  • Executioner can no longer torment when their target becomes evil.
Other Bug Fixes
  • Pets tab now says "Pets" rather than "Hats."
  • Directly clicking on security utilities like Admin is no longer possible if task requirements aren't met.
  • End Game Timer is no longer broken.
Changes and Improvements
Changes
  • Miner now places Polus vents and has an animation paired with it.
  • By default, Sonar now uses Heartbeats instead of arrows to keep track of players.
  • Haunter now marks players with a dark red name when they are revealed.
Improvements
  • Glitch, Morphling, and Swooper now have better vent settings.
  • UI changes are far more optimized now.
  • Destroyed animations are now cleared from memory properly.
Additions
  • TOU Mira: Legacy is now a part of the main mod.
  • Role Name placement is now configurable in terms of size and position.
  • Added configurable mod stamp placement.
  • Added "TV Show" style for Skeld visuals.

entry.title: TOU:R v6.0.0
entry.summary: Town of Us: Reactivated is so back!
entry.content:
Town of Us: Reactivated is so back!​

Our very own Atony has officially updated Town of Us: Reactivated to run on the latest version of Among Us!

Going forward, updates for TOU:R will be for compatibility and quality of life. New roles and modifiers will not be added to this release. See the changelog below for more.

Changelog​

Changelog
Changelog
  • Ported the mod over to the latest releases of Among Us.
  • Added Android support via Starlight.
  • Renamed mod metadata to prevent confusion with TOU Mira.
  • Improved Hats Selection Menu.
  • Added new hats from TOU Mira.
Notes
  • Presets are now located in C:\Users\%user%\AppData\LocalLow\Innersloth\Among Us\reactivated_presets. Make sure to move them over once reaching the main menu.
  • Auto-updater will not currently be used for Reactivated, as it has proven to be unreliable at times.

entry.title: v1.6.2 Update
entry.summary: Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.6.2!
entry.content:
Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.6.2!​

This update includes bug fixes and improvements: see the full changelog below.

As always, be sure to do a fresh install!

Known Bugs:

  • Neutral Wildcard may duplicate the amount of each neutral present if any selected slots are wildcards.
  • Ghostwalkers are sometimes unable to use the Zipline, Platform, or Ladders.

Known Hide n Seek Bugs:

  • The Seeker is missing animations for the hiders.
  • Hiders ignore their vent uses.

Changelog​

Role Bugfixes
Crewmates
  • Medium's Spirit movement no longer carries over from Time Lord rewinds.
  • Killers now get arrows that point to the Haunter when they complete their tasks.
  • Medic no longer breaks when a player is protected by multiple Medics. Only one Medic will be flashed at a time.
Impostors
  • Venerer no longer displays its effects as "Visual" modifiers.
Neutrals
  • Glitch no longer resets mimic cooldowns for other Glitches.
Other Bug Fixes
  • Changing the UI scale mid-game no longer breaks the UI at the top right.
  • Chat messages are now capped to a maximum of 20 public and 20 private chat messages to prevent crashing.
  • Roles are no longer revealed immediately upon death.
  • Pets are removed based on settings properly.
  • Celebrity's cause of death now displays all causes of death.
Other Bugfixes
  • Impostor replaced by a Crewpostor can no longer see their previous task text.
  • Camo Comms no longer shows other player names when revived.
  • Doors can be set to Skeld doors or be flat-out removed properly on Submerged.
  • Private Chat is no longer broken.
  • Players disconnecting from the lobby no longer breaks the player count.
  • Disconnected players no longer leak their role color.
  • Submerged and Level Impostor no longer break when loading base game map assets.
Changes and Improvements
Changes
  • Monarch will no longer be able to change their shield appearance, and is now always Grey. A future patch will allow further configuration, but not to the same degree as before with Warden / Cleric flashing.
  • Seer can no longer compare revealed players.
Improvements
  • It is now possible to disable any host keybind if you tend to misclick.
  • Survivor, Fairy, and 1st Round Shield protection will flash grey, as a way to not appear unresponsive.l/173).
Additions
  • Two custom pets have been added
  • Game Mechanic Option: All Shields Flash Anonymously.
  • Top-Right UI can now be scaled up and down.

entry.title: v1.6.1 Update
entry.summary: Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.6.1!
entry.content:
Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.6.1!​

This update includes bug fixes and improvements: see the full changelog below.

As always, be sure to do a fresh install!

Known bugs with this update:

  • Controlled players (via Parasite/Puppeteer) appear to be stuck in a walk cycle when they are walking onto a wall, showing they are under control.
  • Neutral Wildcard may duplicate the amount of each neutral present if any selected slots are wildcards.
  • Ghostwalkers are sometimes unable to use the Zipline, Platform, or Ladders.
  • When Haunter finishes their tasks, sometimes the Impostors will not get an arrow to the Haunter, essentially screwing them over.
  • Pets aren't removed based on settings properly.
  • Medic Shield still doesn't get shattered properly with the settings.

Known Hide and Seek Bugs:

  • The Seeker is missing animations for the Hiders.
  • Hiders ignore their vent uses.

Changelog​

Role & Modifier Bugfixes
Crewmates
  • Officer no longer breaks across game sessions.
Impostors
  • Grenadier flash no longer breaks kill screens and meetings.
  • Dragging Viper / Rotting bodies no longer breaks Undertaker.
Neutrals
  • Executioner Torment kills players again.
  • Jester Haunt kills players again.
  • Mercenary protection is removed upon their death.
  • Arsonist interactions contribute towards the douse limit.
Other Bug Fixes
  • Spectators that join without running /spec are no longer half-dead.
  • When Crewpostor replaces a real Impostor, the player being replaced gets a proper role.
Other Bugfixes
  • Impostor replaced by a Crewpostor can no longer see their previous task text.
  • Camo Comms no longer shows other player names when revived.
  • Doors can be set to Skeld doors or be flat out removed properly on Submerged.
  • Private Chat is no longer broken.
  • Players disconnecting from the lobby no longer breaks the player count.
  • Disconnected players no longer leak their role color.
  • Submerged and Level Impostor no longer break when loading base game map assets.
Changes and Improvements
Details

Changes dlekS tooltip in the Create Game Menu is legible now. Imitator now shows (Imi) next to their name while imitating roles. Zoom and Wiki buttons can be changed to be below or next to the Settings / Chat button. Amnesiac's Assassin configuration is improved. Lobby view pane has been adjusted to be smaller.

Improvements
  • Assassin is now shown as a modifier, unless Double Shot is present, with a better wiki description.
  • Misguessing now shows who/what was attempted to be guessed in the end game summary PR #173, DivanNL.
Additions
  • Keybind Actions are now available under the local settings, primarily for Android players.
  • The host can now run /kick and /ban mid-game PR #170, VoidChaos

entry.title: v1.6.0 Update
entry.summary: Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.6.0!
entry.content:
Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.6.0!​

This update includes bug fixes and improvements from the previous version(s). As always, be sure to do a fresh install!

Note: Before playing, you must reset your keybinds, otherwise your W key will be bound to the zoom key, and Puppeteer/Parasite will be broken, so on and so forth.

See changelog below for the full list of bug fixes, known bugs and changes/improvements.

Known bugs with this update:

  • Private chats are invisible to players killed mid-meeting.
  • Private chats for living players sometimes get deleted when a new public chat message is added.
  • Controlled players (via Parasite/Puppeteer) appear to be stuck in a walk cycle when they are walking onto a wall, showing they are under control.
  • Neutral Wildcard may duplicate the amount of each neutral present if any selected slots are wildcards.
  • Ghostwalkers are sometimes unable to use the Zipline, Platform, or Ladders.
  • When Haunter finishes their tasks, sometimes the Impostors will not get an arrow to the Haunter, essentially screwing them over.

Known Hide and Seek Bugs:

  • The Seeker is missing animations for the hiders
  • Hiders ignore their vent uses

Changelog​

Role & Modifier Bugfixes
Crewmates
  • Medic can no longer hand out shields again when settings forbid them.
  • Medic shields are destroyed properly if the setting is set.
  • Re-applying Magic Mirrors immediately no longer breaks.
  • Guardian Angel's protection is properly checked.
  • Engineer can no longer bypass Plumber's Barricades.
  • Operative and Sentry's Portable cameras are now functioning on Android.
  • Medium properly hides pets when anonymous players are enabled.
  • Monarch can properly knight regardless of the First Round Use setting.
Impostors
  • Shapeshifter's name is properly changed.
  • Parasite victims properly die when the time runs out.
  • Hypnotist's Hysteria can no longer softlock the player upon death.
  • Warlock's Burst Kill works again.
  • Herbalist's herbs reset properly across rounds.
Neutrals
  • First-Round settings no longer interfere with Amnesiac
  • Fairy can no longer target Neutral Outliers.
  • Spectre can spook properly again.
Miscellaneous Bugfixes
Other Bug Fixes
  • Spectators who join without running /spec are no longer half-dead.
  • When Crewpostor replaces a real Impostor, the player being replaced gets a proper role.
Improvements and Changes
Improvements
  • Egotist and Crewpostor labels are shortened on player names.
  • The Wiki now allows searching by faction/alignment.
  • Disconnected players are kept properly displayed in the meeting and in the end-game summary.
  • Camo Comms, Mix-Up, and Vent System checks are far more optimized now, reducing lagspikes and general instability.
  • Plumber now has a Flush duration, blocking any vents in use for a set duration.
Changes
  • Current Region is now displayed in the lobby.
  • Trapper's feedback now includes Hyperlinks.
  • Many game settings are reorganized.
  • April Fools mode is temporarily removed from the main menu for the sake of stability.
Additions
  • Cleaned bodies can now be set to display as Missing, Disconnected, or Dead, applicable to Viper, Rotting, Chef, and Janitor.
  • Kill Animation background can now optionally be colored based on the killer's Faction or Role Color.
  • Added Role List Bucket tooltips while hovering (PR #156 by Maxi0fc)
  • Investigator footprints can now be set to be based on Distance or Time.
  • New Crewmate Killing role has been added: Officer.

entry.title: v1.5.9 Update
entry.summary: Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.5.9!
entry.content:
Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.5.9!​

This update includes critical changes and bug fixes, and introduces a new role. As always, be sure to do a fresh install!

Known bugs with this update:

  • Operative and Sentry Portable cameras are unusable on Android.
  • Some roles (such as Hunter) are known to have issues on Android, for reasons unknown to us.
  • Private chats are invisible to players killed mid-meeting.
  • Neutral Wildcard may duplicate the amount of each neutral present if any selected slots are wildcards.

See changelog below for full list of bug fixes, changes and improvements.

New Role — The Herbalist (Impostor Power)​

The Herbalist has many abilities tied to one cooldown, either to help Impostors or to affect what others see.

Herablist Abilities:

  • Expose: Expose a player to all Impostors, revealing their role but preventing them from being guessed.
  • Confuse: Confuse a player with fungal spores to prevent them from identifying players.
  • Protect: Protect a player temporarily as if you were a Cleric, including other impostors.

Changelog​

Role & Modifier Bugfixes
Crewmates
  • Monarch's Round One setting is properly checked.
  • May be fixed: Medic Shield is no longer ignored if it is supposed to break.
Impostors
  • Hypnotist no longer breaks Mix-Up or kill animations.
  • Ambusher is no longer caught by Investigator footprints.
  • Traitor is no longer unguessable if Crewpostor is disabled.

entry.title: v1.5.0 Update
entry.summary: Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.5.0!
entry.content:
Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.5.0!​

This version runs on the latest version of Among Us. A fresh install is recommended to ensure no conflicts with old files!​

This update introduces 5 new roles and 2 new Impostor modifiers!

See changelog below for bugfixes, changes and improvements.

New Roles!​

The Monarch (Crewmate Power)​

The Monarch can knight other players, giving them additional votes.

The Sentry (Crewmate Support)​

The Sentry can place additional cameras across the map, which can then be viewed from Security or by players with portable cameras.

The Time Lord (Crewmate Power)​

The Time Lord can rewind time, forcing players to retrace their path and potentially reviving fallen players!

The Parasite (Impostor Powwer)​

The Parasite can overtake a nearby player and temporarily control their movement before killing them.

The Puppeteer (Impostor Power)​

The Puppeteer can control other players and force them to kill someone else.

New Modifiers!​

Circumvent (Impostor Passive)​

You lose the ability to vent around the map.

Deadly Quota (Impostor Passive)​

You must meet your kill quota or lose the game, even if fellow Impostors win.

Changelog​

Role Bugfixes
Crewmates
  • Prosecutor's use is no longer wasted when their selection dies mid-meeting.
  • Jailor uses are no longer removed 2 times in a row.
  • Veteran no longer loses instantly in a 1v1 when on their last alert.
Impostors
  • Traitor can be guessed properly again.
  • Undertaker's Drag/Drop button no longer locks up after consecutive games.
Neutrals
  • Amnesiac, Executioner and Fairy will see their target properly.
  • Doomsayer guesses now appear properly instead of appearing as kills.
Miscellaneous Bugfixes
Modifier Fixes
  • Crewpostor is treated as a regular Impostor and no longer loses when only Crewmates remain.
  • Disperse no longer breaks on Ladders or Platforms.
Other Bug Fixes
  • First round death indicator no longer exposes morphed players.
  • Vanilla roles are now properly clickable in chats to open their wiki entries.
  • Epic Games can use Practice mode again.
Changes, Improvements and Additions
Changes
  • The private chatboxes are no longer toggled via separate buttons, but rather within the chat itself.
  • Local Settings have been split up into two tabs, and the button slider has moved under MiraAPI Settings.
Improvements
  • Morphing into a player with the First Death Shield will show a fake shield.
  • Guesser Menu now allows you to search for roles and modifiers for ease of use.
  • Most cooldowns can now go from 5 seconds all the way to 2 minutes.
  • Options for Sheriff, Vampire, Oracle, and Vigilante are compressed within the wiki.
  • New artwork has been added, and some old artwork has been cleaned up.
Additions
  • Better Airship Option: No Ladder Cooldown.
  • Mystic Option: Show Death Pop-Up.
  • Arsonist Option: Impostor Vision. (Parity Change from TOUR)
  • Altruist Option: Kill on Revive Start.
  • Grenadier Option: Flash During Sabotage. (Parity Change from TOUR)
  • Host-Only Option: Toggle Lobby No-Clip.
  • New Impostor Roles: Parasite and Puppeteer.
  • New Crewmate Roles: Monarch, Sentry, and Time Lord.
  • New Impostor Modifiers: Circumvent and Deadly Quota.
  • Hosts can now add a "LobbyRules.txt" file next to the mod to show their houserules in-game (PR #108, Neil).

entry.title: v1.2.0 Update

entry.content:
Town of Us: Mira has updated to v1.2.0!​

This update is compatible with the latest Among Us version (v17.0.0). Please be sure to update your base game before installing.

See changelog below for bugfixes and improvements.

Note: The Epic Games crash issues have largely been resolved with this update. If you experience crashes or failure to launch, please make a Mira Bug Ticket ticket in the TOU Support Discord server and provide your LogOutput & ErrorLogs (found in the BepInEx folder) and your system operating information.

Changelog​

Role Bugfixes
Crewmates
  • If the Lookout disconnects or gets converted, their feedback will no longer be shown to others in the chat.
  • Snitch is revealed properly to the Traitor as intended.
  • Traitor will always see the Snitch regardless of settings, but Snitch can only see Traitor based on specific settings.
  • Tracker and Engineer get task uses properly.
  • Mirrorcaster can no longer Unleash onto the player that they protect at the same time.
  • The Sheriff can kill the Ambassador without misfiring (bad checks).
  • The Prosecutor button is no longer hidden when the skip button is hidden.
  • Jailee is no longer in Jail if the Jailor is converted.
  • The Mayor no longer trips up Traitor checks from sending repetitive requests to all players.
  • Fixing Comms as the Engineer no longer uses up two charges.
Impostors
  • Traitor can no longer vent as a ghost.
  • Hypnotist applies the same body type to all players, and clears properly without breaking.
  • Swooper player names are no longer revealed during Camo Comms.
  • Morphling player names are no longer revealed during Camo Comms after unmorphing.
  • Ambusher can no longer get outed when they are taking bodies away.
  • When the Ambusher's victim is revived while their body is taken away, the ambusher will no longer softlock.
  • Miner vents are fully disabled from other roles if they aren't visible.
Neutrals
  • Amnesiac Inquisitor can no longer target themselves.
  • Phantom, Executioner, and Jester ghost kills are now run through a more direct method to force a murder at all costs.
  • Glitch player names are no longer revealed during Camo Comms after un-mimicking.
Miscellaneous Bugfixes
Modifier Bug Fixes
  • Celebrity Report no longer gets parsed incorrectly.
  • When Spooked by a Phantom, the Celebrity shows their cause of death as Spooked properly.
Other Bug Fixes
  • Haunter, Phantom, and Snitch now ignore Sabotage and Non-Task Information on the task list.
  • There are now checks to prevent votes on dead players or votes happening from dead players.
Improvements and Changes
Improvements
  • Chat Tags now italicize on hover. (PR #65, Chipseq)
  • Controllers on the Main Menu can now select the April Fools Toggle.
  • Chat is now hidden from recently killed players.
  • Your abilities can no longer be triggered when typing in lovers chat.
Changes
  • Nearly complete Chinese translations, as well as partial translations for Dutch, French, German, Russian, and Spanish.
  • Players can now spectate in games by running "/spec" in their chat.
  • It is now possible to change what ranges of buttons are affected by the starting cooldown, if any.
